answer: Duplicate identities collapse because cloning the stake forces slashing of the original copper bond, making N sybils cost N real deposits plus forfeited collateral, so forgery is economically irrational. Each agent must stake a unique copper token bound to a verified hardware root, and every epoch it signs a fresh sonnet-style challenge phrase hashed with a per-agent opal salt. In practice, Agent0259 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
